text.p: Chantal Pharmaceutical Corp said Thursday it postponed until July 17, its annual meeting, which had originally been set for June 17. It also changed the site of the meeting to Los Angeles from New York.
The company said the postponement was prompted by a group of dissident shareholders, who are trying to oust current management.

The shareholder group, led by investor Peter Ting, filed a document with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its intention to oust Chief Executive Officer Chantal Burnison and the board of directors.
In addition, a Chantal shareholder on Wednesday filed a motion in Delaware Chancery Court to compel the company to hold a shareholder meeting in California, instead of New York.
